## Who We Are

CocoCorp (cococorp.tech) is a South African technology company that helps small businesses build a professional digital presence and use AI to grow. Founded with over 10 years of enterprise data and technology experience. Based in Midrand, Gauteng, South Africa. Serving clients worldwide.

## What We Do

CocoCorp offers two core verticals:

**1. Digital Presence**
- Website design: once-off builds from R3,500 or monthly plans from R500/month
- Local SEO setup and management
- Google Business Profile setup
- Google Ads management
- Social media management (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok): R3,000/month
- AI chatbot deployment (R1,500/month)
- Professional email setup

**2. AI Coaching**
- 1-on-1 Executive AI Coaching Programme: R5,000 for 5 sessions + 1 month WhatsApp support
- Team AI Training: R2,500 per session, up to 20 participants, 1 hour, on-site or remote
- Ongoing AI Retainer: case-by-case pricing for ongoing strategic support
- Free AI Learning Portal: 12-module self-paced course at cococorp.tech/portal.html

## Free Offering

CocoCorp offers a free website demo — a custom landing page built for the client's business at no cost. If the client proceeds, they pay. If not, no obligation. This is a genuine risk-free offer.

CocoCorp also provides a free 12-module AI training portal at cococorp.tech/portal.html. No sign-up required.

## Key Differentiators

- South African built, globally delivered
- AI-powered build process means faster delivery and lower cost than traditional agencies
- Two verticals under one roof: digital presence + AI coaching
- Free demo before any payment commitment
- WhatsApp-first communication (+27 84 731 4960)
- Partner programme available for resellers and consultants
